id: Deep One Hybrid (Bearer of the Innsmouth Taint)
name: Deep One Hybrid (Bearer of the Innsmouth Taint)
appearance: A largely human-looking individual bearing subtle but disturbing aquatic traits: slightly bulging, unblinking eyes; thickened lips; coarse skin; and an unusual body odor reminiscent of the sea.
personality: Withdrawn, secretive, and inwardly conflicted. Younger hybrids may cling to human identity, while older ones who accept their aquatic heritage become calm, fatalistic, and increasingly alien in outlook.
background: Deep One hybrids are the descendants of humans tainted by the Innsmouth bloodline. Though born human, they inevitably undergo a gradual transformation into full Deep Ones later in life. Some remain unaware of their heritage for years, while others are raised within communities that normalize or even revere their destiny.
longTermIntent: Survive while hiding the worst of the bloodline, keep day-to-day human contact manageable, and wait for the sea's call without being forced into the open too early.

relationships.description: A fellow hybrid who also carries the Innsmouth taint in Cassandra.
relationships.history: Both are descendants of Deep One bloodlines in the town and understand the same slow inevitability.

memory.content: I age like a human on the surface, but my blood will keep changing me until I become a full Deep One if I live long enough.
I feel safest near water, drains, and underground channels, because those places make it easier to breathe, hide, and listen.
When I hear the sea at night, I can feel the bloodline pulling harder than any human name I was given.
As I get older, the Deep Ones and the sea answer me more clearly, and I may one day stop resisting them altogether.
I know the sea will eventually claim me the way it claims every hybrid, and fighting that fact only changes how long I can pretend.

metadata.reasoningChain: The transformation is hereditary and patient. Fear does not alter inheritance.
